drupal.subject: Variant theme-incompatible: theme-core-incompatible.patch
drupal.note: GitHub read-only mirror of git.drupalcode.org/project/drupal (drupal.org unreachable from the lab container)

environment.drush: not used (owner: git checkout of core, no Drush); core/scripts/dr and the UI stand in, see observations
environment.server: PHP built-in web server (php -S) with .ht.router.php in the site root, SQLite database, one worker process

anon.label: GET /user/login as an anonymous visitor, with no cache rebuild and warm caches (the configured front page, /admin/welcome, needs a login)

anon_cold.label: empty every cache table (as a deploy or a cache backend restart does, without running Drupal's rebuild), then GET /user/login as an anonymous visitor

updatephp.label: GET /update.php/selection (stands in for drush updb: it lists pending updates; no update is run)

cr.label: core/scripts/dr cache:rebuild (stands in for drush cr), then GET /user/login

en_self.label: install the fixture extension itself from the UI: tick it on /admin/modules and submit, or follow the theme's Install link on /admin/appearance (stands in for drush en; the recipe command cannot see an extension added since the last cache rebuild)

en_other.label: core/scripts/dr recipe tests/info-yml/recipes/install_syslog: install an unrelated core module with a recipe

exin_self.label: core/scripts/dr ex:install <the fixture extension> -y: core's own install command (aliases exin, pm:install, pm:enable, enable, en; it resets the extension lists first), the closest equivalent of drush en; then one anonymous request to /user/login, then cache:rebuild and the request again

exin_other.label: core/scripts/dr ex:install syslog -y: install an unrelated core module with core's install command; then one anonymous request to /user/login, then cache:rebuild and the request again

recovery.label: break the site (cache:rebuild), remove the fixture (delete it, or put the valid files back if it was installed), then GET /user/login without and with cache:rebuild

placements.module/uninstalled: modules/custom/infofix, not installed (Standard site; the installer installs Update by default)
placements.module/uninstalled-no-update: as uninstalled, on the same site after uninstalling the Update module
placements.module/installed: modules/custom/infofix, installed before the file was broken
placements.theme/uninstalled: themes/custom/infofix_theme, not installed (Standard site; the installer installs Update by default)
placements.theme/uninstalled-no-update: as uninstalled, on the same site after uninstalling the Update module
placements.theme/installed: themes/custom/infofix_theme, installed and set as the default theme before the file was broken
placements.profile/uninstalled: profiles/custom/infofix_profile on a Standard site (a profile that is not the site's profile)
placements.profile/installed: profiles/custom/infofix_profile, the profile the site was installed with (it installs node, block, dblog and update, and no page cache)
placements.libraries/contrib: libfix v2 (with tests/ fixtures that have no type) copied into modules/contrib, not installed
placements.libraries/updated: libfix v1 installed, then its files replaced by v2 (what an update does to the code base)
